meta.name: approval-tests
meta.description: Writes approval tests (snapshot/golden master testing) for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java. Use when verifying complex output, characterization testing legacy code, testing combinations, or working with .approved/.received files.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编写批准测试验证复杂输出和遗留代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为遗留代码或复杂输出创建快照测试。
copy.tagline_en: Write approval tests to verify complex outputs and legacy code.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to create snapshot tests for legacy code or complex outputs.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能编写审批测试（快照测试），用于Python、JavaScript/TypeScript或Java。它会生成测试代码，通过比较输出与已批准的“黄金主”文件来验证，无需编写单个断言。
howto.when: 当用户要求验证复杂输出、描述遗留代码或测试组合时触发。

say.text: 为我的Python函数编写一个审批测试，验证其输出。
say.note: Claude会生成使用verify()的测试代码。

say.text: 帮我为这段遗留代码创建特征测试。
say.note: Claude会生成审批测试来捕获当前行为。

say.text: 测试所有输入组合，使用verify_all_combinations。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can write approval tests (snapshot/golden master testing) for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java. It generates test code that verifies output by comparing against saved 'golden master' files instead of writing individual assertions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to verify complex output, characterize legacy code, or test combinations.

say_en.text: Write an approval test for my Python function to verify its output.
say_en.note: Claude generates test code using verify().

say_en.text: Create a characterization test for this legacy code.
say_en.note: Claude generates an approval test to capture current behavior.

say_en.text: Test all input combinations using verify_all_combinations.
